notes.title: Update #6 is available now
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

A new update is available now for the Windows and Linux versions of Wizardry 6 that contain the following changes:
[list]
[*]Windows - Updated David Walter's DOSBox to the NOV 1, 2018 build,
[*]Linux - Updated David Walter's DOSBox version to Version 17. This version however, now requires the Linux installation to be a 64-Bit version. 32-bit is no longer supported.
[*]Windows and Linux - Removed dosbox_gamelink.exe and the Custom Readme from the game files per the authors request,
[*]Windows and Linux - Updated supplied Source Code where possible.
[/list]
Enjoy the update!
Daniel,
Nightdive Studios

notes.title: Update #4 is available now
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

A new update for Wizardry 6 is available now which includes the following:
[list]
[*]Windows - Updated David Walter's Custom DOSBox to Revision 6
[*]Linux - Improved Launcher
[*]Linux - Updated Libraries and DOSBox build
[*]Mac - Upgraded to Boxer 2.0 engine. This is a huge change and you will need to rename the save file which the old version of Boxer was using. Go into /Users/Your Name/Library/Application Support/Boxer/Gamebox States/, find the folder called 'B6F9B4FF1CD278771E55FFED2EB09414F9826879' and rename it to either 'Wizardry 6 English' or 'Wizardry 6 German' depending on which language of the game you are using. Apologies for the inconvenience. This will not happen again but it is necessary in order to provide future updates.
[/list]

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update #2 is available now
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,
A New update for Wizardry 6 is available now. Here are the change notes:

[list]
[*]Added a version of Vanilla DOSBox which includes 'Sound Popping' fixes for Wizardry 6. Users will be able to choose which verion of DOSBox they want to use when launching the game. (Thanks to David Walters for permission to use his build of DOSBox) (Windows)
[*]Updated DOSBox Daum to the latest build (17/11/2013) (Windows/Linux)
[*]Fixed Aspect Ratio issues in Vanilla DOSBox (Linux)
[*]Slowed down the game by about 10% to allow some battle sound effects to finish playing in certain situations.
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update #1 is available now
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,
Wizardry 6 has been updated after being in Beta for a while. Here are the changes:
[list]
[*]Changed the main DOS game folder from wizardry6 to BANE. This corrects an issue some people were having relating to the numbers in the DOSBox path. Your Save Games (e.g SAVEGAME.DBS, Ignore SCENARIO.HDR if one is present) will be located in the old Wizardry 6 folder. You can copy them from there into the BANE folder to restore them. This a necessary change and one that will not happen again.
[*]The DOSBox Console will no longer display on launching the game (Windows)
[*]Updated Libraries (Linux)
[*]Fixed sound popping on the main menu when moving the mouse (Linux)
[*]Fixed "Inconsistency detected by ld.so: dl-open.c: 695: _dl_open: Assertion ` dl_debug_initialize (0, args.nsid) ->r_state == RT_CONSISTANT' failed!' (Linux)
[/list]
Enjoy!
